landing_hero_subtitle: The production SvelteKit frontend for LangGraph agents. Ship a secure, customizable UI without a TypeScript backend — OIDC-ready and built to stay maintainable for years.
landing_hero_note: Explore streaming, tool calls, and auth — no local setup required.
landing_gap_title_line1: Building the agent is the easy part.
landing_gap_body: Python and LangGraph make agentic AI tractable. But the frontend landscape leaves you choosing between tools that break under maintenance pressure, lock you into opinionated stacks, or demand a separate TypeScript backend just to render a chat window.
landing_pain_1: Upstream UI changes break your customizations without warning
landing_pain_2: Codebases too complex or generated to meaningfully audit
landing_pain_3: TypeScript backends you didn't ask for sitting between you and your Python agent
landing_pain_4: Forked repos that drift from upstream and lose security coverage
landing_pain_5: Integrations that work in the demo but crumble months into production
landing_features_subtitle: React has plenty of agent UIs. Svelte deserves a first-class LangGraph frontend — fast, joyful to customize, and built for production ownership.
landing_features_footnote: Built with Svelte, bits-ui, shadcn-svelte, Proto, and Moon — pinned toolchains across Node and Python.
landing_feature_1_description: Connects directly to your LangGraph server. No TypeScript backend required. Full streaming for tool calls and complex agentic workflows.
landing_feature_2_description: OIDC built in. Auditable code for security teams — with long-term security support as a design goal, not a patch-and-pray cadence.
landing_feature_3_description: Every component layer is independently configurable. Built on bits-ui and shadcn-svelte — override anything, extend everything.
landing_feature_4_description: All LLM providers via the OpenAI-compatible protocol — Anthropic, OpenAI, local models, Azure, and more.
landing_steps_title: Clone it. Run it. Ship it.
landing_steps_subtitle: Today: clone or fork the repo. Soon: install as a package — no fork required.
landing_step_1_description: Install Proto in the repo root (`proto install`). Pins Moon, pnpm, Node, and Python per .prototools — one toolchain for the whole monorepo.
landing_step_2_description: `cp .env.example .env`, then `moon :dev :oidc-mock` — frontend, backend, and OIDC mock with hot reload. Always include :oidc-mock for local auth.
landing_step_3_description: Deploy with the included config — Docker, your OIDC provider, your LangGraph server. Pull upstream security patches without the rewrite treadmill.
landing_persona_1_description: Stop spending sprints on React glue. Focus on the agent — connect a frontend that speaks LangGraph natively without a TypeScript-heavy stack.
landing_persona_2_description: Ship branded agent UIs you can customize, maintain, and hand over to clients with confidence.
landing_persona_3_description: Embed OIDC-ready agent chat your security team can audit — built for the long haul inside your existing product.
landing_persona_4_description: Deploy LangGraph-powered chatbots without a custom frontend team — fork, brand, and ship support agents on a budget.
landing_landscape_subtitle: Every tool in this space makes different trade-offs. Here's an honest look at where svelte-langgraph fits alongside other solid options.
landing_landscape_note: Every project here represents real effort from people who care about the ecosystem. Choose svelte-langgraph for quality, security, and long-term maintainability — when a production-grade UI you can audit and support for years matters more than the broadest feature set out of the box.
landing_landscape_streamlit_note: Streamlit excels at data apps and demos — a different category than production agent chat UIs.

landing_final_title_line2: The frontend is how users trust it.
landing_final_body: Open source. MIT licensed. Security-first. Fork it, configure it, and ship something you'll still be proud of next year.
